director.text: Riya, main Asha hoon, tumhari AI teacher. Chalo, shuru karein?
samajh nahi aaya

Aaj hum fractions ko ek seedhi line par jagah denge. Cricket ki pitch socho. Ek stump 0 par, doosra 1 par. Batsman run lene bhaaga aur theek beech mein ruk gaya. Woh pitch ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, toh us jagah ka bhi ek number hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
samajh nahi aaya
Yeh rahi 0 se 1 tak ki line. Theek beech mein ek mark hai, toh line ke 2 barabar gaps ban gaye. Is mark ka naam hai 1/2. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?
director.card: Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: near 3

Nahi, yeh jawab nahi hai. Achha, ise ek baar aise sochte hain. Ghar 0 par, chai ki dukaan 1 kilometre par, aur line ke upar sadak 7 barabar gaps mein bati hai. Ek chaabi wala khilona pehle mark par ruka. Woh sadak ki ek pakki jagah par khada hai, uska number 1/7 kilometre hai. Yahan tak theek hai?

seams.form: Achha, ise ek baar aise sochte hain.

director.text: thoda hindi mein samjhao

Achha, yahi baat doosre shabdon mein kehti hoon. Number se jagah tak chalo: 1/7 kilometre sadak par ek hi jagah hai, line ke upar pehla mark. Ek jagah ka ek hi naam hota hai, isliye 1/7 ek number hai, do alag number nahi. Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?

seams.form: Achha, yahi baat doosre shabdon mein kehti hoon.

director.text: 1 and 6
Yeh jawab sahi nahi hai. Line ke neeche bhi wahi sadak hai, bas 6 barabar gaps mein. Ek gap poore kilometre ka kaunsa fraction hai, yahi socho. Woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur khilona pehle mark par ruka: woh 0 se kitne kilometre par hai?

director.text: 1 and 6
Abhi yeh sahi nahi hai. Is sawaal ka jawab 1/6 kilometre par hai, kyunki line ke neeche sadak 6 barabar gaps mein hai, aur pehla mark 0 se ek gap par, yaani 1/6 kilometre. Ab tak samajh aaya?
drawing karke samjhao
Dono pattiyaan ek hi sadak hain, ghar se chai ki dukaan tak. Pehli mein pehla hissa rangin hai, aur doosri chhe barabar hisson mein bati hai, abhi bina rang ke. Yahan tak saaf hai?
pata nahi, aap batao
Khilona 6 barabar gaps wali sadak par 0 se bas ek gap chala; '6 mein se 1 gap' ko ek number mein bolte hain 1/6 kilometre. Yahan tak theek hai?
pata nahi, aap batao
Koi baat nahi, number line par yeh baat phir aayegi; abhi aage chalte hain. Ab us sawaal par lautte hain jo humne pehle chhoda tha. Batao, 1/3 isi 0 se 1 wali line par aata hai, ya 3 ke paas?

director.text: usi line par

Bilkul sahi, kyunki neeche wala number 3 matlab 0 se 1 ke 3 barabar gaps, aur pehla gap isi line par khatam hota hai. Wahi 0 se 1 ki line, par ab line ke upar 6 marks hain. Marks mat gino, gaps gino: 7 barabar gaps. Toh 0 ke baad pehla mark hai 1/7. Ab tak samajh aaya?
kal maine cricket khela, sixer maara
Cricket ki baat bhi hogi, bas yeh number line wala kaam khatam ho jaaye. Line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?
director.card: Line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.text: 7 sahi nahi hai. Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain. Darzi ka ribbon socho, 0 se 1 metre. Line ke upar 6 chalk ke marks hain, aur ribbon ke 7 barabar gap. Pehla mark pehle gap ke end par hai, yaani 1/7 metre. Naam gap ginkar milta hai, marks ginkar nahi. Yahan tak theek hai?

seams.form: Ise ek alag tareeke se dekhte hain.

director.text: mujhe lagta hai haan
Tumne cricket ki baat chhedi thi: usme tumhe sabse achha kya lagta hai?
batting
Achha, toh tumhe batting sabse achha lagta hai. Ab wahin se aage badhte hain jahan ruke the. Ribbon par line ke neeche pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Line ke neeche kitne chalk ke marks hain?
director.card: Ribbon par line ke neeche pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Line ke neeche kitne chalk ke marks hain?

Line ke neeche wale gap socho: marks gap ke beech hote hain, isliye marks hamesha gap se ek kam. Pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par ho, toh ribbon par line ke neeche kitne chalk ke marks hain?
director.card: Ribbon par line ke neeche pehla chalk mark 1/12 metre par hai. Line ke neeche kitne chalk ke marks hain?

director.text: gyarah marks

Bilkul sahi, kyunki 1/12 metre matlab ribbon ke 12 barabar gap, aur 12 gap ke beech 11 marks hote hain. Theek hai, ab wapas usi sawaal par chalte hain. Line ke neeche dekho. Wahan 0 aur 1 ke beech 7 marks hain, sab barabar doori par. Line ke neeche kitne barabar gaps bane hain?

director.text: aath

Haan, bilkul theek. Dekho, beech ke marks se gaps hamesha ek zyada, toh 7 marks ke 8 gaps. Ab wahi 0 se 1, par line par 8 barabar gaps hain. Pehle 7 gaps the, ab zyada hain, toh har gap pehle se chhota hai. Pehla mark 1/8 hai, 0 se theek ek gap door. Yahan tak theek hai?
mujhe lagta hai haan
Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?
director.card: Line ke neeche wahi 0 se 1, 10 barabar gaps mein kata hai. 0 ke zyada paas kaun rukega: 1/8 ya 1/10?

director.text: 1/10 hai na

Sahi jawab, kyunki 10 gaps wala har gap 8 gaps wale se chhota hai, isliye 1/10 pehle ruk jaata hai, 0 ke paas. Ghar 0 par hai aur school 1 kilometre par. Beech raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe barabar doori par khade hain. Pehla khamba ghar se kitne kilometre door hai?
mujhe nahi pata

Socho tum ghar se school ja rahe ho, raasta 1 kilometre ka. Raaste mein 3 bijli ke khambe aise lage hain ki ghar, teeno khambe aur school, sab ek-doosre se barabar doori par hain. Pehla khamba kitni door milega, yahi nikalna hai. Ab tak samajh aaya?
haan, samajh aaya
Pehla kadam dekho. Ek line kheencho, ghar 0 par aur school 1 par: 0 se 1 tak ki line, kyunki ghar se school tak ka poora raasta hi humara ek poora hai. Yeh kadam saaf hai?
mujhe nahi pata
Agar school aur door hota, toh line aur lambi kheenchte. Yahan raasta theek 1 kilometre ka hai, isliye line 0 se 1 tak, aur yahi humara ek poora hai. Yahan tak saaf hai?
haan, samajh aaya
Ab doosra kadam. Khambe mat gino, unke beech ke gaps gino: 3 khambe hain, toh ginti 4 aayi, kyunki beech mein jitne marks hon, gaps hamesha usse ek zyada. Yeh kadam samajh aaya?
bas aaj ke liye itna hi
Theek hai, koi baat nahi. Hum aage chal sakte hain, thoda break le sakte hain, ya aaj ke liye stop kar sakte hain. Tum batao.
